tex_content.html:
Corollary
[characterization of warped-product constant-curvature metrics]

Source: petersen:page-0149, petersen:page-0150 ↗ thm:pet-ch4-brinkmann-critical-point ↗ ex:pet-ch4-hess-f-space-forms 1. ch4:4.3.4If $f(p)=0$, $df|_p=0$, and $\mathrm{Hess}\, f=(1-kf)g$, then near $p$ the metric is the warped-product metric of curvature $k$ from subsection 3.1.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch4-brinkmann-constant-curvature \sketch By subsection 3.2, the metric has round angular part and warping function $\rho =f'$. The initial-value problem $f''=1-kf$, $f(0)=f'(0)=0$ has the solutions listed in subsection 3.1: $\rho =r$ for $k=0$ and $\rho =\operatorname {sn}_k(r)$ otherwise. These are precisely the local constant-curvature models.

□
